observed_behavior: Gwen tests registered through its reviewed dual Vitest and ordered runner wrapper were rejected.
expected_behavior: Explicitly declared project-owned registration boundaries can supply executable test locators.
causal_mechanism: The locator admitted only imports from a fixed third-party module list.

anti_pattern.structural_description: External runner provenance was treated as exhaustive of executable registration boundaries.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Owned wrappers preserve registration behavior but have their own symbol declaration.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Opt-in belongs to the canonical exported implemented runner, not a call, import, ambient declaration or ordinary helper.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Resolve the symbol and require an exported body or initializer marked with the exact JSDoc tag traceabilityRunner; retain disabled-suite checks.

applicability_conditions: A reviewed project-owned runner registers actual tests
confirmation_evidence: The imported custom wrapper reproduction failed before the change; declaration and suite regression cases pass after correction.
regression_proofs: tsts/test/traceability-graph.test.ts: reviewed exported custom runners opt in at their canonical declaration
tsts/test/traceability-graph.test.ts: custom runner opt-in does not admit unmarked helpers, call-site tags or skipped registrations
tsts/test/traceability-graph.test.ts: custom suite opt-in preserves skipped enclosing suite exclusion
